Now please see above lines and clarify the same. Jaza kallah previously Asked: Agar Masjid main Kharji hissa na ho aur kabhi kabhi jamat e sani karni ho to kya kar sakte hai aur uska kya tareeqa hoga? Answer: 9900 04 Jan, 2009 (Fatwa: 22/18=B/1429) According to Hanafi Fiqh, second Jamat is makrooh in the mosque of locality. If the jamat is once performed there is no need to do the second jamat. Remaining people should offer salah individually. If there is any shop, house or open place outside the main mosque where jamat is possible then it can be done there. and Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) Knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband 2286 views Q. answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 160733 Country: India Title: Salah procedure during travel Question: When I am travelling in a flight, I could not able to offer the fardh salah in the standing position. Can I offer salah in the sitting position? If I offer the salah in sitting position whether I have to repeat the salah again or not? Answer ID: 160733 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 799/913/H=8/1439) If your plane lands at a time that you may offer salah easily on ground then you should offer salah after you get down from the plane. However, if you fear that your salah will be missed then you should offer it in the plane. If you feel too weak to stand, and offered Salah facing the direction of Qiblah and sitting on floor (away from seat) then even your fardh salah will be valid and you will need not to reoffer it. In case you offered your salah sitting while you were able to offer salah standing then your fardh salah will not be valid. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
